    AI Overview
    The 2025-26 NBA season saw a fierce rivalry between the LA Clippers and Golden State Warriors, culminating in a 2026 Western Conference 9/10 Play-In Tournament matchup on April 15, 2026, at the Intuit Dome. The Clippers won the regular-season series 3-1, including a 115-110 victory on April 12, 2026, to set up the play-in rematch. 
    Key 2025-26 Season Timeline 
    • Oct 28, 2025: The Warriors defeated the Clippers 98-79.
    • Jan 5, 2026: The Clippers defeated the Warriors 103-102.
    • Mar 2, 2026: The Clippers defeated the Warriors 114-101.
    • Apr 12, 2026:
      The Clippers defeated the Warriors 115-110 in the regular-season finale to secure the No. 9 seed.
    • Apr 15, 2026 (Play-In): The No. 10 seed Warriors played at the No. 9 seed Clippers at the Intuit Dome. 
    The winner of the April 15, 2026, play-in game advanced to play the Phoenix Suns, while the loser was eliminated from the playoffs.
